short.q: Describe a suitable cool-down for a hockey player.
short.model: Gradually reduce pulse by jogging then walking, then stretch the main muscles used.

short.q: State two ways to reduce the risk of injury on a playing field.
short.model: Check the pitch for holes or glass and wear appropriate footwear; also warm up or follow the rules.

short.q: Explain how RICE helps a sprained ankle.
short.model: Rest prevents further damage, ice and compression reduce swelling and pain, and elevation reduces blood flow to the area.

short.q: Give two disadvantages of using performance-enhancing drugs.
short.model: Health damage and a ban or disqualification; also fines and public humiliation.

short.q: Explain why a performer might use blood doping.
short.model: It raises red blood cell count so more oxygen reaches muscles, delaying fatigue in endurance events.
